issues.problem: wa-contrast explain said dropping the particle before は always changes the meaning; false for time words (日曜日は / 日曜日には both fine).
issues.action: Changed to 'usually' and added the time-word exception.

issues.problem: wa-negative explain said the は of ではない can never be left out; でない is standard inside noun-modifying clauses (学生でない人), so the rule applied mechanically would cause errors.
issues.action: Limited the rule to main clauses and named the でない exception.

issues.problem: wa-negative explain said が stays 'only' when reporting an absence; neutral negative news in general keeps が (雨が降っていません).
issues.action: Broadened it to neutral reports of fact, with a second example.

issues.problem: wa-negative mistake note said flatly that the negative of です is ではありません; でありません survives in formal speech-making style.
issues.action: Scoped the note to everyday Japanese and mentioned じゃありません.
